error.description: Kept for older clients: a code or a message, as each endpoint returned before.

details.description: Extra data, where an endpoint has some.

Error400.description: Invalid request (code names the problem, message explains it).

Error401.description: Not signed in (code: authentication_required), or a bad bot signature.

Error403.description: Forbidden: cross-site request, premium only, or not open to a Telegram session.

Error503.description: A service the operation needs is unavailable.

session.name: session
session.description: Session cookie from signing in on the website, or from POST /telegram/login for the Telegram bot. Writes from browsers must be same-origin (Origin / Referer are checked).

botSignature.name: X-NosiFit-Bot-Signature
botSignature.description: HMAC-SHA256 over method, path, timestamp, nonce and body with the bot's shared secret (shared/bot_signature.py). Only the NosiFit Telegram bot has the secret.
